acceptance.text: The claimed-case reconciles: at re-entry, a driver.dispatch (or paired external effect) found claimed with an expired claim and no live owner is reconciled - the engine determines whether the external action left durable evidence (a sealed handoff receipt, a journaled attempt) and either adopts the result or clears the claim for a fresh try - instead of writing dispatch_uncertain and aborting RECOVERY_UNCERTAIN on every re-entry forever (the branch at internal/runtime/dispatch.go:1939-1982, which today cannot even see claim expiry: journal.Effect carries CurrentClaim but no expiry, internal/journal/model.go:32-45, while ExpiresAt lives only on journal.Claim). Pinned by runtime tests over the sworn#207 reproduction shape: clean release, claimed dispatch, claim expired hours earlier.

The operator always has an admissible verb: in the reconciled-uncertain shape, either reconciliation itself unblocks the run, or retry is admissible so the operator can authorize fresh tries - never the sworn#207 lockout where run loops RECOVERY_UNCERTAIN, takeover refuses because the cleanly-released owner is invisible (currentOwnerOnConnection returns found=false for pending-empty, internal/journal/control.go:173-208), and retry refuses because no /t3 operational failure was ever written (control.go:265-279). Pinned by an end-to-end runtime test driving the wedge shape to a recovered run.

The board tells the truth it checks: the uncertain state's presentation derives from the same gate conditions the verbs evaluate - an uncertain run yields a needs-you row (today ProjectNeedsYou matches attention, parked, takeover_required, awaiting_approval and an uncertain run produces no row at all, internal/cockpit/catalog.go:99-186) and its next-step text names a verb that is currently admissible, never the unimplemented 'Recover the run' (presentation.go:107-111) or a takeover the gate refuses. Pinned by cockpit projection tests over the wedge fixture.

Control refusals carry their reason: CONTROL_REJECTED distinguishes at least stale-generation from not-takeoverable, and ATTENTION_REJECTED names the oversize-answer bound when that is the cause - the sworn#207 unlabelled-refusal tail - pinned by control tests asserting distinct detail per refusal cause.

constraints: Exactly-once discipline is the boundary: reconciliation may adopt durable evidence or clear a claim for a fresh try only when the journal proves which is safe; when it genuinely cannot tell, the uncertain state remains - but as an answerable, presented state with an admissible operator verb, never a silent loop.

Evidence basis: run 2026-08-17-google-native-driver-r3 (journal preserved as the reproduction bundle) - the escape cost a journal abandonment, an in-flight try, and a re-asked attention whose answer lived only in the dead journal.

The status vocabulary may grow (a reconciled or answerable-uncertain presentation) but existing states keep their meanings; no exactly-once, cardinality, or authority assertion weakens anywhere in test/e2e.
Check evidence belongs in the submission's checks field, never in files added to the repository.

Revision 2 scope boundary: test/e2e enters this slice's edit surface solely for the claimed-state and uncertain-state recovery conformance scenarios in test/e2e/topology_recovery_linux_test.go - the file the r2 candidate had to touch (CANDIDATE_SCOPE_FAILED named exactly this one path) because its scenarios pin the pre-reconciliation RECOVERY_UNCERTAIN semantics this slice replaces; an operator sweep confirms it is the only e2e surface pinning those semantics. Repinned scenarios encode the reconciled semantics; no exactly-once, cardinality, or authority assertion is weakened anywhere in test/e2e, and the e2e gate remains CI-executed, declared not executed, per ADR-0010.
